objects.query: SELECT BasedOnId, CanRamp, ConfigureDuringSale, Description, DisplayUrl, Family, Id, IsActive, IsAssetizable, IsSoldOnlyWithOtherProds, Name, ProductCode, QuantityUnitOfMeasure, SpecificationType, StockKeepingUnit, Type, UnitOfMeasureId FROM Product2 ORDER BY StockKeepingUnit ASC

SELECT Code, Description, Id, MaxBundleComponents, MinBundleComponents, Name, ParentGroupId, ParentGroup.Code, ParentGroup.ParentProduct.StockKeepingUnit, ParentProductId, Sequence FROM ProductComponentGroup ORDER BY ParentProduct.StockKeepingUnit ASC, Code ASC

SELECT ChildProductClassificationId, ChildProductId, ChildProductRole, ChildSellingModelId, DoesBundlePriceIncludeChild, Id, IsComponentRequired, IsDefaultComponent, IsQuantityEditable, MaxQuantity, MinQuantity, ParentProductId, ParentProductRole, ParentSellingModelId, ProductComponentGroupId, ProductRelationshipTypeId, Quantity, QuantityScaleMethod, QuoteVisibility, Sequence, UnitOfMeasureId, ChildProductClassification.Code, ChildProduct.StockKeepingUnit, ParentProduct.StockKeepingUnit, ProductComponentGroup.Code, ProductRelationshipType.Name FROM ProductRelatedComponent ORDER BY ChildProductClassification.Code ASC, ChildProduct.StockKeepingUnit ASC, ParentProduct.StockKeepingUnit ASC, ProductComponentGroup.Code ASC, ProductRelationshipType.Name ASC
SELECT Name, Status, PricingTerm, PricingTermUnit, SellingModelType FROM ProductSellingModel ORDER BY Name ASC, SellingModelType ASC
SELECT Name, IsActive, IsStandard, CostBookId, ValidFrom, ValidTo, Description FROM Pricebook2

SELECT Id, IsDefault, Product2Id, ProductSellingModelId, ProrationPolicyId, Product2.StockKeepingUnit, ProductSellingModel.Name, ProductSellingModel.SellingModelType FROM ProductSellingModelOption ORDER BY Product2.StockKeepingUnit ASC, ProductSellingModel.Name ASC, ProductSellingModel.SellingModelType ASC

SELECT Name, IsActive, IsDerived, Pricebook2Id, Product2Id, ProductSellingModelId, UnitPrice, CurrencyIsoCode, Product2.StockKeepingUnit, ProductSellingModel.Name FROM PricebookEntry ORDER BY Product2.StockKeepingUnit ASC, Pricebook2.Name ASC, CurrencyIsoCode DESC, Name ASC, ProductSellingModel.Name ASC
SELECT CatalogId, Code, Description, Id, IsNavigational, Name, ParentCategoryId, SortOrder FROM ProductCategory ORDER BY Catalog.Code ASC, ParentCategory.Code ASC, Name ASC

SELECT CatalogId, Id, IsPrimaryCategory, ProductCategoryId, ProductId, ProductCategory.Code, Product.StockKeepingUnit FROM ProductCategoryProduct ORDER BY ProductCategory.Code ASC, Product.StockKeepingUnit ASC, Catalog.Code ASC
